title: Profile Outcome Pilot v1 — execution order allocation
description: Which condition runs first for each task, derived from one recorded seed after the task set is frozen. This file is a schema; no allocation has been generated. An allocation that exists before the tasks are frozen would let the tasks be chosen with the order already visible.

tasks_sha256.description: Digest of the frozen tasks.json this allocation was drawn against. If tasks.json changes, this allocation no longer describes it and the pilot is void rather than re-derived.

seed.description: Recorded so the allocation can be re-derived and checked. Generated once, after the task set is frozen. Re-rolling it after seeing any result invalidates the pilot.

generated_at_utc.description: Must be later than the task set's frozen_at_utc.

allocation.description: One entry per task. Both orders must appear across the six; an allocation that runs the same condition first every time controls for nothing.

first.description: Which condition executes first for this task. The other runs second. Both conditions always run.
